page.title: Settings
page.banner: Company-wide settings: identity, fiscal years and periods, chart of accounts, posting, analytics, VAT codes, payment terms, approval workflows, roles and permissions, audit logs, scheduled AI analyses. Every change requires the matching permission.
page.help: Configuration is centralised here; settings specific to a module stay in its own “Settings” menu.

languages.mine_hint: Language of your screens and how dates and numbers are shown. With no choice, the company settings apply.
languages.company_hint: Defaults for members and documents. Accounting, tax and payroll rules do not depend on the language.
languages.timezone_help: IANA identifier. Empty: each browser's time zone. Accounting dates never change day.
languages.allowed_help: No box ticked: all active languages. French, the source language, always remains available.
languages.fallback_note: Your preferred language is no longer allowed by the company: the company language applies.
languages.load_error: Language preferences could not be loaded.
